conversion_audit.schema_renaming: The 19 names containing :: were renamed with _ and all references updated by the converter. After this mechanical reference renaming, all 129 schema definitions are identical.

spec_notes.contract: The success schemas leave results[].key and results[].id unconstrained and do not correlate them with the resource index. Generated full responses can contain arbitrary key/id values unrelated to the resource index, unlike the documented canonical results envelope. The node correctly rejects unmatched references; these are generated-response parser advisories, not request failures.

Two unused operations declare collectionFormat: csv on a scalar string query csv_file, which Swagger does not permit. swagger2openapi --patch removes those annotations; scalar string encoding is unchanged and the original published bytes remain pinned.
